text: 截至10月30日晚间，42家A股上市银行2026年三季报已全部披露完毕。数据显示，42家A股上市银行前三季度营业收入总共为46577.14亿元，同比增长7.79%；净利润总共为17467.90亿元，同比增长3.78%。已披露净息差的36家银行，前三季度净息差平均值为1.55%，其中18家银行净息差同比回升或保持稳定。（央视财经）
text_en: As of the evening of October 30, all 42 A-share listed banks had fully disclosed their 2026 third-quarter reports. Data show that the 42 A-share listed banks reported total operating revenue of 4,657.714 billion yuan in the first three quarters, up 7.79% year on year, and total net profit of 1,746.790 billion yuan, up 3.78% year on year. Among the 36 banks that disclosed net interest margins, the average NIM in the first three quarters was 1.55%, with 18 banks seeing NIM rise year on year or remain stable. (CCTV Finance)
